and righteous nature is revealed if Karakamsa happens to

One lacks power of expression, 
or will be an indistinct speaker if the 2nd from Kara-

The person commits sinful deeds and 
becomes a hypocrite if Ketu joins Karakamsa

Malefics in the 3rd from. 
Karakamsa make one brave.

Saturn in 
Karakamsa or in the Sth from it indicates Breat ner- 
vøusness in assemblies.

consequent.text: Jaimini has 7 chara (movable) karakas — Atma, Amatya, Bhratru, Matru, Putra, Gnathi, Dara — assigned by degree-in-sign, any planet able to acquire any karakatwa.

quote:
There are 7 main karakas in Jaimini, viz., 
(1) Atma, (2) Amatya, (3) Bhratru, (4) Matru, (5) Putra, 
(6) Gnathi and (7) Dara.
